cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.26%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -0.91%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.96%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.96%, WFRD +7.82%, VRT +5.20%, GEV +4.85%, CEG +4.74%. Laggards: MPC -1.63%, EOSE -1.49%, EQT -1.19%, FSLR -0.77%.
